# Soft Bento UI

Public documentation for the portable UI layer used by PrintOS. React 19, HeroUI v3 and Tailwind CSS v4.

- Quick Start: /soft-bento-ui/quick-start
- All Components: /soft-bento-ui/components

- Accessibility: /soft-bento-ui/accessibility
- Agents: /soft-bento-ui/agents
- Skills: /soft-bento-ui/skills
- MCP: /soft-bento-ui/mcp
- Resources: /soft-bento-ui/resources
- Agent instructions: /soft-bento-ui/files/AGENTS.md
- Design contract: /soft-bento-ui/files/DESIGN.md
- HeroUI v3: https://github.com/minhkhanhdev/soft-bento-ui . @soft-bento/ui is not claimed to be published on npm. Merge instructions into the host repository; never overwrite its permissions or product rules. All examples are synthetic. No credentials or business data are required.
